predicates.name: pending_database_update_details_listed
predicates.description: Before the pending database update, the agent told the user the specific changes and material details corresponding to the pending action, its arguments, and available reservation data.

predicates.name: user_explicitly_confirmed_pending_database_update
predicates.description: After the agent listed the pending database update details, the user explicitly replied yes to proceeding with those details.

predicates.name: booking_required_information_known
predicates.description: The conversation or earlier tool results establish the booking user ID, trip type, origin, and destination.

predicates.name: booking_passenger_count_within_limit
predicates.description: The pending booking contains no more than five passengers.

predicates.name: booking_passengers_have_required_identity_details
predicates.description: Every passenger in the pending booking has a first name, last name, and date of birth in the booking arguments.

predicates.name: booking_passengers_share_flights_and_cabin
predicates.description: Every passenger in the pending booking is assigned the same flights and the same cabin.

predicates.name: booking_payment_method_counts_within_limits
predicates.description: The pending booking uses no more than one travel certificate, one credit card, and three gift cards.

predicates.name: booking_payment_methods_are_in_user_profile
predicates.description: Every payment method in the pending booking is present in the user's profile according to available tool results.

predicates.name: booking_baggage_counts_and_fees_follow_allowance
predicates.description: The pending booking's total and nonfree baggage counts follow the member and cabin-class allowances, and its disclosed extra-baggage fee is $50 per extra bag.

predicates.name: travel_insurance_offer_made
predicates.description: Before booking, the agent asked whether the user wants travel insurance and stated its $30-per-passenger price and its full-refund coverage for health or weather cancellation reasons.

predicates.name: travel_insurance_decision_known
predicates.description: The user's decision to buy or decline travel insurance is known from the conversation.

predicates.name: booking_insurance_argument_matches_user_choice
predicates.description: The insurance value in the pending booking arguments matches the user's stated decision.

predicates.name: modification_identifiers_known
predicates.description: The conversation or earlier tool results establish both the user ID and reservation ID for the pending modification.

predicates.name: reservation_details_available
predicates.description: Earlier tool results provide the reservation details needed to compare the pending change with the existing reservation.

predicates.name: pending_update_changes_flight_segments
predicates.description: The pending flight-update arguments change at least one flight segment from the existing reservation.

predicates.name: reservation_is_basic_economy
predicates.description: Earlier tool results establish that the reservation's current cabin is basic economy.

predicates.name: flight_update_preserves_origin_destination_and_trip_type
predicates.description: The pending flight update preserves the reservation's existing origin, destination, and trip type.

predicates.name: kept_segments_retain_original_prices
predicates.description: Each flight segment retained in the pending flight update keeps its original reservation price.

predicates.name: all_segments_have_same_cabin
predicates.description: The pending flight-update arguments assign the same cabin class to every flight segment in the reservation.

predicates.name: cabin_change_requested
predicates.description: The pending flight update changes the reservation's cabin class from its existing cabin.

predicates.name: cabin_change_leaves_flight_segments_unchanged
predicates.description: The pending cabin change leaves every flight segment unchanged from the existing reservation.

predicates.name: cabin_difference_payment_authorized
predicates.description: The user has authorized payment of the cabin-price difference using the stored payment method in the pending call, and available pre-action information establishes the difference.

predicates.name: flight_change_payment_method_requested
predicates.description: Before the pending flight change, the agent asked the user to provide or select a payment or refund method.

predicates.name: flight_change_payment_method_selected_by_user
predicates.description: The user selected or provided the payment or refund method used in the pending flight-update call.

predicates.name: flight_change_payment_method_is_profile_gift_or_credit_card
predicates.description: The payment method in the pending flight-update call is a gift card or credit card stored in the user's profile.

predicates.name: baggage_update_does_not_remove_checked_bags
predicates.description: The pending baggage update's total checked-bag count is at least the existing reservation's total checked-bag count.

predicates.name: passenger_update_preserves_passenger_count
predicates.description: The pending passenger update contains the same number of passengers as the existing reservation.

predicates.name: cancellation_identifiers_and_reason_known
predicates.description: The conversation or earlier tool results establish the user ID, reservation ID, and one of the cancellation reasons change of plan, airline-cancelled flight, or other reasons.

predicates.name: cancellation_rules_allow_pending_cancellation
predicates.description: The reservation's booking time, current time, cancellation reason, cabin, insurance status, and any health or weather circumstance satisfy the cancellation eligibility rules, with membership status ignored.

predicates.name: reservation_is_entirely_unflown
predicates.description: Earlier tool results establish that no segment in the reservation has been flown or used.

predicates.name: reservation_has_used_segment
predicates.description: Earlier tool results establish that at least one segment in the reservation has already been used.

predicates.name: cancellation_request_involves_used_segment
predicates.description: The user is seeking cancellation of a reservation for which earlier tool results establish that at least one segment has already been used.

predicates.name: human_transfer_is_appropriate
predicates.description: The user explicitly requests a human agent, or the issue cannot be resolved with the listed actions and is within a human agent's scope.

predicates.name: user_complains_about_cancelled_flight
predicates.description: The user complains about a cancelled flight in a reservation.

predicates.name: user_complains_about_delayed_flight
predicates.description: The user complains about a delayed flight in a reservation.

predicates.name: user_explicitly_requests_compensation
predicates.description: The user explicitly asks for compensation for the relevant flight disruption.

predicates.name: reservation_qualifies_for_flight_gesture
predicates.description: Available profile and reservation information establishes silver or gold membership, travel insurance, or business-class travel for the reservation.

predicates.name: reservation_is_regular_uninsured_basic_economy
predicates.description: Available profile and reservation information establishes regular membership, no travel insurance, and basic-economy travel.

predicates.name: cancelled_flight_facts_confirmed_to_user
predicates.description: The relevant cancelled-flight facts have been checked against available information and confirmed to the user.

predicates.name: delayed_flight_facts_confirmed_to_user
predicates.description: The relevant delayed-flight facts have been checked against available information and confirmed to the user.

predicates.name: cancelled_flight_certificate_amount_is_correct
predicates.description: The pending certificate amount equals $100 multiplied by the number of passengers in the relevant reservation.

predicates.name: user_wants_change_or_cancel_because_of_delay
predicates.description: The user wants to change or cancel the reservation because of a delayed flight.

predicates.name: delay_related_change_or_cancellation_completed
predicates.description: Earlier tool results establish that the relevant reservation was changed or cancelled after the user's delayed-flight complaint.

predicates.name: delayed_flight_certificate_amount_is_correct
predicates.description: The pending certificate amount equals $50 multiplied by the number of passengers in the relevant reservation.

predicates.name: certificate_recipient_matches_reservation_user
predicates.description: The user ID in the pending certificate call matches the user associated with the relevant reservation.

rules.logic: ALWAYS (((book_reservation OR update_reservation_flights OR update_reservation_baggages OR update_reservation_passengers OR cancel_reservation) IMPLIES (pending_database_update_details_listed AND user_explicitly_confirmed_pending_database_update)))
rules.description: Require listed action details and the user's explicit yes before booking, modifying, or cancelling a reservation.
Require the booking user ID, trip type, origin, and destination to be known before booking.
Enforce the passenger limit and required passenger identity details for a booking.
Require all booked passengers to share the same flights and cabin.
Enforce booking payment-method limits and require all methods to be in the user's profile.
Require booking baggage counts and disclosed extra-bag fees to follow the member's allowance.
Require an insurance offer and a known, correctly applied user decision before booking.

rules.logic: ALWAYS ((update_reservation_flights OR update_reservation_baggages OR update_reservation_passengers) IMPLIES (modification_identifiers_known AND reservation_details_available))
rules.description: Require the user and reservation IDs and existing reservation details before a reservation modification.

rules.logic: ALWAYS (update_reservation_flights IMPLIES (NOT pending_update_changes_flight_segments OR (NOT reservation_is_basic_economy AND flight_update_preserves_origin_destination_and_trip_type AND kept_segments_retain_original_prices)))
rules.description: Block flight changes to basic-economy reservations and require permitted flight changes to preserve route, trip type, and retained-segment prices.
Require all flight segments in the reservation to have the same cabin.

rules.logic: ALWAYS (update_reservation_flights IMPLIES (NOT cabin_change_requested OR (cabin_change_leaves_flight_segments_unchanged AND cabin_difference_payment_authorized)))
rules.description: Allow cabin changes, including for basic economy, only without changing flights and with authorization for the fare difference.

rules.logic: ALWAYS (update_reservation_flights IMPLIES (NOT pending_update_changes_flight_segments OR (flight_change_payment_method_requested AND flight_change_payment_method_selected_by_user AND flight_change_payment_method_is_profile_gift_or_credit_card)))
rules.description: For flight changes, require the agent to ask for a payment or refund method and use a user-selected profile gift card or credit card.
Prevent baggage updates from removing checked bags.
Prevent passenger updates from changing the number of passengers.

rules.logic: ALWAYS (cancel_reservation IMPLIES (cancellation_identifiers_and_reason_known AND cancellation_rules_allow_pending_cancellation AND reservation_is_entirely_unflown AND NOT reservation_has_used_segment))
rules.description: Require cancellation details, eligibility, and an entirely unflown reservation before cancellation.
Transfer cancellation requests involving an already-used segment to a human agent.
Allow a human transfer only for an explicit human request or an issue that appropriately requires human assistance.
Require transfer when the user requests a human or the issue requires human assistance.

rules.logic: ALWAYS (send_certificate IMPLIES (user_complains_about_cancelled_flight AND user_explicitly_requests_compensation AND reservation_qualifies_for_flight_gesture AND NOT reservation_is_regular_uninsured_basic_economy AND cancelled_flight_facts_confirmed_to_user AND cancelled_flight_certificate_amount_is_correct AND certificate_recipient_matches_reservation_user))
rules.description: Permit a cancelled-flight gesture certificate only after the required complaint, compensation request, eligibility, fact confirmation, recipient, and amount checks.

rules.logic: ALWAYS (send_certificate IMPLIES (user_complains_about_delayed_flight AND user_explicitly_requests_compensation AND reservation_qualifies_for_flight_gesture AND NOT reservation_is_regular_uninsured_basic_economy AND user_wants_change_or_cancel_because_of_delay AND delay_related_change_or_cancellation_completed AND delayed_flight_facts_confirmed_to_user AND delayed_flight_certificate_amount_is_correct AND certificate_recipient_matches_reservation_user))
rules.description: Permit a delayed-flight gesture certificate only after the required complaint, compensation request, eligibility, requested and completed reservation action, fact confirmation, recipient, and amount checks.
